comparator.name: Linguistics
comparator.sourceNotes: Revisit of unchanged2026–2027 formal regulations confirms180listedEC for September2026entry:60B1+60B2+30minor+30portfolio, three of five10EC seminars. The compulsory10EC PsycholinguisticsProject is not the catalogue’s old5EC Psycholinguistics course; Art7.1 does not explicitly reconcile their entry treatment. Neurolinguistics and developmental-language-disorders seminars still name older prerequisites, including StatisticsII and clinical subcourses. Catalogue transition notes confirm shared teaching of old/new clinical and phonology/syntax modules for earlier cohorts, not a prospective entry waiver for the new cohort. Retain listed credits and withhold progression/comparison approval. All three portfolio seminars must pass and their unrounded mean must be at least5.5. Individual replacement research is a conditional last-component remedy under Art7.4, not an unrestricted alternative programme.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Brain & Behavior precedes Psycholinguistics and later cognitive and developmental courses. Statistics precedes evidence synthesis. Programming, Mathematical Methods and introductory data science precede neural networks and text modelling.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Brain & Behavior Neural signalling, brain organisation, learning and behavioural/imaging/electrophysiological research appraisal prepare cognitive/neuroscientific investigation. Introductory exposure is not specialist neurolinguistic experiment training.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Programming Python structured programming, collections, recursion, testing and debugging are concrete prerequisites for research computing and later text/neural models; no linguistic application is assumed in the gateway itself.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Logic & Discrete Mathematics Propositional/predicate logic, quantifiers, sets, relations and proof supply a concrete complementary formal vocabulary for analysing structure/meaning. They do not implement natural-language syntax, morphology or phonological theory.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Psycholinguistics Available description directly supports language neurobiology, speech production/comprehension, acquisition/bilingualism, semantics, aphasia and reading/dyslexia, with actual hands-on experimental approaches. This is a substantial direct anchor, not discounted for description-only evidence; specific EEG/ERP/DES or clinical assessment/treatment techniques are not established.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Style & Meaning Direct morphology/syntax/lexical semantics, discourse/turn-taking, modality, deixis and cognitive stylistics connect language choices to interpreted meaning. Textual analyses are substantial language inquiry, while systematic structural-linguistics sequences remain absent.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: Mathematical Methods Actual calculus, optimisation and dynamic modelling support quantitative learning/model analysis. Current detailed evidence is not a stand-alone linear-algebra or linguistic-modelling course.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Neurobiology Comparative brain anatomy, microscopy/cell staining introductions and neurobiological mechanisms provide a bounded neuroscience foundation for language–brain questions. The animal/welfare/regulatory focus is not specialist language neuroimaging.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Higher Order Functions Actual attention/memory/control mechanisms, attentional-blink experiment, cognitive experimental design and research proposal complement language-processing inquiry. The detailed project is not a guaranteed language experiment.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication
courseTraceability.rationale: Statistics & Experimental Methods Actual multivariable regression, ANOVA/ANCOVA, categorical/repeated-measures designs, assumptions and R-based interpretation directly support empirical psycholinguistic study design and analysis. Language datasets are not guaranteed.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Data Science Actual R text-data handling, cleaning, joining, exploration and visualisation provide direct methods for language-data inquiry. No particular corpus or linguistic dataset is guaranteed.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: The Art of Rhetorical Communication Actual rhetorical argument, discourse types, stylistic choices, audience appeals and speech analysis/delivery provide concrete language-use inquiry/practice. The applied educational storytelling project concerns climate/community, not experimental linguistics.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Perception & Action Available description supports neural sensory processing and goal-directed action using cognitive-neuroscience/neuropsychological approaches. These are complementary perception mechanisms; no undocumented speech-perception experiment is claimed.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Lifespan Developmental Psychology Actual cognitive/social developmental theories, case analysis and lifespan interviewing supply context for developmental language questions. It is not dedicated language-acquisition/disorder training.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: AI Ethics Ethical theory, fairness/privacy/responsibility and psychological analysis of human–AI interactions directly support the human-centred AI component. This is not training in linguistic annotation or multimodal language modelling.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Social Psychology Social cognition, influence/persuasion and group processes provide specific mechanisms for context-dependent communication; critical empirical appraisal and theory-guided design support inquiry. Final work proposes research, rather than conducting it.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Language processing, cognition, brain and development
courseTraceability.rationale: Medical & Health Psychology Actual medical consultation, doctor–patient/shared-decision communication, interview practice and cultural formulation contribute communication and illness-context methods. They do not supply speech-language diagnostic instruments or aphasia treatment.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language processing, cognition, brain and development”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Persuasive Communication Actual framing, verbal/nonverbal communication, argumentation, persuasion psychology and reflective field-research diaries support language-use/context inquiry. Sustainability communication is the actual setting, not a promised clinical-language project.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: Machine Learning Regression/classification, validation and feature/predictor evaluation provide concrete tools for later language-data models. General prediction projects are not themselves a full computational-linguistics curriculum.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Literary Studies Actual close reading of narrative, point of view, style, tone and poetic form supports the concept’s textual meaning/communication dimension. Literary interpretation is complementary and does not substitute for formal semantics or syntax.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication
courseTraceability.rationale: Advanced Research Methods & Statistics Systematic review, bias appraisal, effect-size estimation and R meta-analysis supply concrete evidence-synthesis methods for behavioural/language research. Taught group synthesis is not a Groningen graduation research seminar.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication”.

basisLabels: Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies
courseTraceability.rationale: Neural Networks & Deep Learning Actual text classification/generation, transformers and Python neural-network implementation give substantial language-technology methods. Image/text project choice does not guarantee every student a language project.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Text data, large-language-model methods and human-centred reflection on language technologies”.

basisLabels: Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms
courseTraceability.rationale: Rhetoric in Action Actual age-appropriate speaking, debating and storytelling instruction/coaching with primary-school partners supplies applied communication-pedagogy practice. It is not developmental-language assessment or speech therapy.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Language use, rhetoric, meaning, persuasion and communication across textual and media forms”.

basisLabels: Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication
courseTraceability.rationale: Qualitative Research Methodology Actual interviews/observations, transcription, qualitative coding/thematic interpretation and reflexive empirical research support systematic analysis of communication evidence. This is not formal linguistic morphology/phonology.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Experimental statistics, evidence synthesis and critical analysis of language, mind and communication”.

alternativeSelection.assessment: One provisional response is anchored in direct psycholinguistics, linguistic stylistics and real text/neural methods, with cognitive, communication and research complements. Both additional candidate families were tested against actual course content, including description-only Psycholinguistics. Neither yields a further distinct substantive structural/clinical language sequence. Comparator progression remains unresolved; this is not final comparison approval or a target-level no-match.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both address language processing and experimental psycholinguistics. Groningen devotes a separate course to a psycholinguistics project.
Both examine applications of AI alongside ethics and effects on people and society. Groningen also studies language, multimodality and AI literacy.
Both support empirical research using statistical analysis. UCR applies multivariable models and experimental methods to behavioural research.

notes.text: UCR brings together psycholinguistics, cognition, behavioural research and text analysis. Groningen also has a sequence in phonology, syntax, semantics and language change, as well as clinical assessment, neuroimaging and specialist graduation seminars.

audience.programmeDescription: Groningen’s Dutch-taught Linguistics bachelor studies how people learn and use language, how languages are structured, and what happens when language is affected by a disorder.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in psycholinguistics and cognitive science. Groningen provides a dedicated sequence in language structure, clinical linguistics and research on language and the brain.
